classes.name: results
classes.reason: write_staged explicitly calls os.fsync and os.close before returning, so the rank that issues it waits for the data to be durable, and since the barrier only occurs once per generation (not per write) other ranks are busy with their own tasks_per_rank writes rather than waiting on this one.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: write_buffered only does os.write/os.close with no fsync, so the write is left in the page cache and the rank continues immediately to the next task without waiting for storage completion, and other ranks are independently doing their own generation loop rather than blocking on this write.
